RAR 1.5, 2.0 and 2.9 sample archives from the test fixtures of the [rars](https://crates.io/crates/rars) crate
(0.12.3), under the Apache-2.0 license. `rar250_*.rar` are its `rar250/AUDIO.RAR`, `BIGLZ.RAR` and `SOLID.RAR`, and
`ppmd_lz_repeat_rar3.rar` its `ppmd_lz_repeat_rar3.cbr`. The `rarvm_*` archives each use one of RAR 3's standard
filters; the `ppmd_*` ones use PPM blocks, some with LZ matches and filters inside them.
